name: The Severed Head
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, you uncover a male orc's severed head. Bring it to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: A Grim Find
sections.body: Your digging turns up a male orc's head, ragged where it was cut from the neck. Its lips curl in a snarl, and dark eyes glare defiantly. Bring the head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Nazeer Looks Closer
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike recognizes Marg Nighteye's head at once, though he had feared Marg was dead. The ragged wound leaves him wondering whether a weapon made the cut or a beast killed the agent. Nazeer wants to solve the mystery and learn whether the Alliance was behind Marg's death.

faq.q: Where do you bring the severed head?
aliases: where to turn in severed head
faq.answer: Bring the severed head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: What does the head look like?
aliases: what is in the loose dirt
faq.answer: It is a male orc's head, ragged where it was cut from the neck, with lips drawn in a snarl and dark eyes glaring defiantly.

faq.q: What comes after the severed head?
faq.answer: The next step is The Troll Witchdoctor.
